The 100 Best Restaurants in New York City

Le Bernardin

Midtown, Manhattan

Eric Ripert's temple to French seafood is as flawless as ever. The barely-touched fish preparations remain among the finest in the world.

Atomix

NoMad, Manhattan

The most refined Korean tasting menu in the city. Each course at Atomix is a meditation on Korean culinary tradition reimagined through a modern lens.

Lucali

Carroll Gardens, Brooklyn

The Carroll Gardens pizza institution that spawned a thousand pilgrimages. Mark Iacono's thin-crust pies are worth every minute of the notoriously long wait.
